column1: # 2606.19544v1 Table 9: Per-benchmark evaluation configuration. Item counts are the verified n_samples values from agreement-protocol JSON outputs. Consistency runs indicate the number of independent replicate evaluations per item used for the test–retest and self-consistency metrics; only MT-Bench and JudgeBench are in the consistency cohort, with Phase 4 (Tier 1) using 5 runs per item and Phase 7 (Tier 3 SoTA) using 3 runs per item. RewardBench is included in the agreement and bias-audit protocols only. † The RewardBench item count of 2{,}981 is the n_samples value verified from the post-randomization agreement runs; if the body text reports 2{,}985 , the figure should be updated to match this value.
